question:
Which of the following letter-number clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the given series to make it logically complete?

HKB 11, FIZ 19, DGX 27, BEV 35, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca63fa0a9b1d8d94e9032be998e74b7faff301d8847e785439c04e89b02dfd4.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/758d213d653653088a4734491bd29d96f95973a5fbcfae18b19d273a6ecd5e9d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f6c1f8dcb9b8a7cd373f1068981631147df5c2590fb7595453579797623942b0.png]
